iran_nuclear.name: Iran Nuclear
iran_nuclear.notes: Day 72. RISING: Islamabad talks COLLAPSED - US demands 20-year enrichment freeze, Iran offers 5 years. US/Iran seeking interim memorandum instead. IAEA locked out 8+ months - 'cannot verify enrichment suspension.' 440kg 60% uranium location unknown. CNN: US/Israel targeting nuclear scientists. NPT Review Conference starts Apr 27. IAEA DG Grossi urges strict verification. AP: China weighing custody of Iran uranium stockpile. Probability 36%. Rising.

iran_conventional.name: Iran Conventional
iran_conventional.notes: Day 72. CRITICAL: Hormuz RE-CLOSED Apr 18 after brief reopening - IRGC fired on at least 3 commercial vessels. Iran says will restrict ships until US blockade ended. Trump: 'may not extend ceasefire' if talks fail. Ceasefire expires Apr 22 - NOW 2 DAYS AWAY. Iran NOT planning to attend Apr 20 talks in Islamabad. US seized Iranian ship attempting to break blockade Apr 19. Oil spiking. Second round of talks in serious doubt. Bloomberg: Iran can sustain war for months. Probability 48%. Rising.

israel_lebanon.name: Israel-Lebanon
israel_lebanon.notes: Day 72. STABLE: 10-day ceasefire mostly holding, expires Apr 26. US-brokered deal signed Apr 16. Israel holding buffer zone 10km inside Lebanon. Hezbollah NOT part of deal - remains armed. Trump invites Israel & Lebanon leaders to White House. Israel says will use 'full force' in Lebanon despite truce if soldiers face threat. In-principle agreement to extend ceasefire reported. Bloomberg: clashes dent truce hopes. Probability 17%. Stable.

turkey.name: Turkey
turkey.notes: STABLE: Roketsan opened Europe largest warhead plant (Lalahan), fuel plant, missile integration facilities Apr 7. Largest defense investment in Republic history ($3B). TAYFUN Block-4 ballistic missiles delivered to armed forces. SOM cruise missiles delivered. Air-launched ballistic missile tests planned 2026. NATO weighing expanding missile defenses at Turkish bases amid Iran war. Iranian missiles intercepted over Turkish airspace. Probability 6%. Stable.

india.name: India-Pakistan
india.notes: STABLE: CFR warns India-Pakistan armed conflict likely in 2026 - Tier II risk. India summoned Iran ambassador after Indian vessel attacked in Hormuz. India rejected US mediation claims. Hormuz closure threatens India energy imports severely. Diplomat: economic brunt of prolonged war borne by both countries. India and Pakistan offering escorts as ships pass through Hormuz. Probability 7%. Stable.

russia.name: Russia (Nuclear Signaling)
russia.notes: Day 74. RISING: Finland parliament vote on nuclear weapons hosting expected. First of 64 F-35A nuclear-capable jets arriving 2026. Kremlin: deployment poses threat, will force countermeasures. Finnish professor warns Finland could be first target in NATO-Russia war. Denmark intel: Russia ready for localized war in 6 months. Russia reinforcing nuclear/Arctic assets. Last US-Russia nuclear pact expired Feb 2026. Lukashenko: Belarus and Russia 'walking on thin ice.' Probability 33%. Rising.

china.name: China
china.notes: RISING: US intelligence indicates China preparing weapons shipment to Iran - air defense systems, advanced radar. CBS: China weighing supplying Iran advanced radar. NYT details decades of Chinese weapons transfers. China says military activities around Taiwan 'reasonable and justified.' ISW/AEI: PRC infiltration into Taiwan documented. Taiwan opposition blocking defense procurement. Xi met KMT Cheng Li-wun. Philippines opened coast guard base on Thitu Island. US redeploying from Pacific to Middle East benefits China. NYT: Iran's resistance offers uncomfortable lessons for China re: Taiwan. Probability 44%. Rising.

north_korea.name: North Korea
north_korea.notes: Day 70. RISING: Launched multiple ballistic missiles toward sea Apr 18 from Sinpo area - 7th test of 2026. Japan strongly protested. Kim oversaw 3-day weapons test series Apr 6-8 including cluster-bomb warheads, 5-missile test from Choe Hyon destroyer, ICBM engine test. Anti-ship and cruise missiles tested from destroyer Apr 13. Constitutional nuclear status irreversible. ODNI confirms full US mainland ICBM range. Polymarket tracking missile test by Apr 30. Probability 13%. Rising.

russia_ukraine.name: Russia-Ukraine
russia_ukraine.notes: War Year 4, Day 1175+. RISING: Russia launched one of LARGEST attacks of 2026 - 659 drones + 44 missiles, 16+ killed, 118+ wounded. Ukraine devastating Russian oil infrastructure - 40% of export capacity disabled. Baltic ports Primorsk (40% storage lost), Ust-Luga (30%), Novorossiysk hit, Crimea Feodosia destroyed. Ukraine launched 7,000+ long-range drones in March. Germany commits EUR300M + 5,000 drones + 10 bilateral air defense agreements. Pope issues urgent plea. Russia threatens European industries funding Ukrainian drones. Polymarket ceasefire by Apr 30: 0.4%. Probability 35%. Rising.

pakistan_afghanistan.name: Pakistan-Afghanistan
pakistan_afghanistan.notes: STABLE: 'Open war' continues - Pakistan bombed major cities including Kabul. China-mediated Urumqi 2nd round concluded - agreed not to escalate but fighting continues. Border clashes ongoing. Pakistani Taliban announced 3-day ceasefire for Eid. Pakistan operations against Taliban to continue despite peace talks. CSIS: crisis drifting from resolution. Probability 5%. Stable.
